title: Mitosis merge-boundary activation and SAST residue

Runbook Sections 2-5 applied by the human -- machine user, PAT scoped to Actions:Read, branch ruleset, merge-strategy decision -- and each invariant confirmed against the runbook's Section 7 verification table
Build A is LIVE, not inert: a real mitosis run clears the merge-boundary preflight end-to-end instead of halting on it

The 3 NARROW pragmas from 0038 carry one-line boundary guards: ledger-lint.mjs:77, ledger-lint.mjs:79 (escapeIdentifier at :13 escapes only $), and live-accept.mjs:357 (extractVariant exported at :613)

spine.active_goal: Make Build A actually work. Runbook Section 6 is now APPLIED and merged (PR #7, squashed into 00f495d). Build A remains INERT until the human applies Sections 2-5 -- GitHub account actions no agent can perform. The SAST residue is discharged as a security matter per 0049; what remains is prose cleanup plus one hardening judgment call.
spine.next_step: AWAIT go on SAST cleanup -- no longer security work per 0049. (1) DELETE the prose trailing the nosemgrep pragma at the 5 defective sites: ledger-lint.mjs:77/:79, live-accept.mjs:357, live-inject.mjs:233, live.mjs:216; per no-comments, delete don't update -- the trail is in 0038/0049. Leave the 14 UPHELD alone. open_risks: Build A is shipped but INERT. rulesets and rules/branches/main both return [] -- no ruleset, no branch protection, so the merge boundary is fiction today and nothing downstream can be exercised end-to-end.

NEW (0049): 9 PartialParsing warnings leave regions UNSCANNED in 6 shell hooks including secret-scanner.sh, plus 2 non-code files. CI shares this blind spot, so 'main is clean' means 'clean in what semgrep could parse' -- weakest in the security-relevant hook layer.

0047 is UNENFORCED: delete_branch_on_merge is still false and squash/rebase are still enabled, which is why PR #7 landed squashed (single parent). Config fix: disable squash and rebase repo-side so the merge button can only produce merge commits.

Engine gap nobody owns: if a child PR goes conflicted after retarget, GitHub cannot build the merge ref, no run executes, and the stale green survives. The ship stage treats conclusion=success as GREEN (mitosis.js:4596) without checking mergeability or recency.

Per 0048, whether an empty bypass list binds the repository OWNER on a User-owned repo is UNTESTED, not false. Test empirically after Section 4: open a throwaway PR and attempt a self-merge. The PR #7 self-merge did not test it -- reviews was [] and no ruleset existed.

Re-verify suites with `node --test <dir>/*.test.mjs`. A bare directory fails MODULE_NOT_FOUND on Node 26 and LOOKS like a real failure. No node_modules exists or is needed. Suite is now 1347 tests, not the 1217 recorded earlier.

The p/default pin is HASH-ONLY -- content was never vendored despite b2f45bb being titled 're-vendor'. Verified INTACT on 2026-07-27 (0049), so re-adjudication is not due, but the next real drift still forces a from-scratch pass with no diff to read.
Decision numbering is global across threads and NOT contiguous. Disambiguate by SLUG, never by number.

Worktrees semgrep-pin, boundary-preflight, and ci-retarget-rerun all hold fully-merged work and are prunable, but squash-merge means `git branch --merged` will not list them. Cleanup is destructive; offered, NOT performed.
